title: SCI Transmit
text: Transmit data from target via serial communication interface (SCI) to host, 1 input, 1 output, {Additional package terminator} sets Indicates end of data; {SCI module}, {Additional package header} Indicates start of data, {Frame size} sets the length of data to be received, {Wait until previous data transmitted} sets the wait until data received in previous time step and {Output status} sets the option to display the transmit status during data. Values come from the instance.

ports.name: Data
ports.summary: Data written to serial bus scalar | vector

ports.name: Status
ports.summary: Data transmitted at given time step scalar

params.name: SCI module
params.values: SCI module for communication A (default) | B | C | D

params.name: Additional package header
params.values: Indicates start of data ’S’ (default) | string | char | number from 0 to 255

params.name: Additional package terminator
params.values: Indicates end of data ’E’ (default) | string | char | number from 0 to 255

params.name: Frame size
params.values: Specify length of data to be received 600 (default) | any positive integer

params.name: Wait until previous data transmitted
params.values: Wait until data received in previous time step is sent on (default) | off

params.name: Output status
params.values: Option to display the transmit status during data transmission off (default) | on
